newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares down but off lows, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares down but off lows, seen stable.

text.p: Swedish shares were lower at midday on Monday but had recovered from morning lows triggered by New York's Friday dive.
At 1000 GMT, the general index was down 1.02 percent at 3,121.06 in turnover of 2.14 billion crowns. Dealers expected the market to stay at these levels for the rest of the day.
"People are selling the market across the board and traders are steering the market," a trader said.
"I think there are buyers who are waiting to step in, but they might hold off ahead of monetary policy meetings this week in Germany and the U.S.," a trader said.
